title: MTech Project
standfirst: A 20 credit project in machine learning and AI, usually done at your workplace, from proposal to final report.
syllabus_body_html:
The MTech Project (DA6901) is the last step of the MTech in AI and ML. It is a 20 credit project in the broad area of machine learning and AI, done in a company or a research lab and evaluated the same way as IIT Madras web MTech programmes.

When you can start: after 154 credits, with all BS degree requirements and the 3 core PG Diploma courses complete. The MTech must be finished within 8 years of starting the programme.

Before you start:

  • A no objection letter from HR at the company where you work.
  • A letter from an internal guide at the company, with at least 5 years of experience and preferably your reporting manager.
  • If you run a family business or work in a partnership or proprietorship firm, the project is done at a premier institute such as an IIT or IISc instead.

The three stages:

  • Proposal: slides presented to a committee of IITM professors. It can be part of your daily work, but it needs a clear research component. You get up to three attempts.
  • Mid-term report: about 4 months after the proposal.
  • Final report and presentation: 8 to 12 months after the proposal, depending on the work.

IITM faculty evaluate the progress; the project itself is shaped by you and your internal guide. Any IP stays with the company.
